description: Look up one star in ESA Gaia DR3 by its source_id and return its full astrometric and photometric record: position, parallax with its uncertainty, derived distance in parsecs and light years, proper motion, radial velocity, all three Gaia magnitudes and colour, effective temperature, surface gravity, and the RUWE astrometric quality flag (values above ~1.4 mean the single-star solution is a poor fit, often a binary).

source_id.description: Gaia DR3 source_id, e.g. "65225812899613312". These are 18-19 digit integers — pass as a string so precision is not lost.

name: gaia_source_by_id
title: Gaia Source By Id
